CALLBACK_WORLD_IN_ON_GAME_START.message: World-dependent object access appears inside on_game_start.
CALLBACK_WORLD_IN_ON_GAME_START.suggestion: Move actor/world logic to actor_on_first_update and keep on_game_start for callback registration.

HOTPATH_CONFIG_READ.message: Hot path appears to read config or construct ini state.
HOTPATH_CONFIG_READ.suggestion: Cache config outside update paths and refresh on apply/load callbacks.

HOTPATH_FULL_SCAN.message: Hot path appears to run an unbounded table/storage scan.
HOTPATH_FULL_SCAN.suggestion: Bound work per tick or maintain an indexed cache.

HOTPATH_STRING_WORK.message: Hot path performs repeated string work.
HOTPATH_STRING_WORK.suggestion: Precompute strings or move parsing outside per-frame callbacks.

HOTPATH_UI_MCM_GET.suggestion: Read MCM settings on apply/change callbacks and cache runtime values.

IMPORT_TOP_LEVEL_IGNORED.message: Imported mod root contains top-level files outside gamedata.
IMPORT_TOP_LEVEL_IGNORED.suggestion: Review whether these files are docs only; package_project copies gamedata payload only.

LOCALIZATION_LEGACY_ENCODING.message: Localization XML uses a legacy encoding.
LOCALIZATION_LEGACY_ENCODING.suggestion: Use xml_localization_tool.py prepare-edit before editing and finish-edit before finalizing.

LOCALIZATION_MISSING_ID.message: Referenced localization id is not defined under configs/text.
LOCALIZATION_MISSING_ID.suggestion: Add the missing string id to the project localization XML for every supported language.

LUA_51_UNSUPPORTED.message: Lua source uses syntax or helpers outside Lua 5.1 expectations.
LUA_51_UNSUPPORTED.suggestion: Keep runtime code Lua 5.1 compatible for Anomaly.

LUA_HIDDEN_GLOBAL.message: Bare assignment may create a hidden module global.
LUA_HIDDEN_GLOBAL.suggestion: Use local for private state or an explicit exported function/table for public API.

LUA_OPTIONAL_UI_MCM_UNGUARDED.message: ui_mcm is used without a nearby optional dependency guard.
LUA_OPTIONAL_UI_MCM_UNGUARDED.suggestion: Guard with if ui_mcm then ... and provide defaults when MCM is absent.

LUA_UNSAFE_ALIFE.message: alife() is used without a nearby nil guard.
LUA_UNSAFE_ALIFE.suggestion: Store alife() in a local and return safely when it is nil.

LUA_UNSAFE_DB_ACTOR.message: db.actor is used without a nearby db/db.actor guard.
LUA_UNSAFE_DB_ACTOR.suggestion: Guard engine-facing access with if not db or not db.actor then return end.

LUA_UNSAFE_LEVEL.message: level is used without a nearby availability guard.
LUA_UNSAFE_LEVEL.suggestion: Guard level-dependent calls and keep them out of root/on_game_start setup.

MCM_GENERIC_ID.message: MCM option id is too generic and may collide.
MCM_GENERIC_ID.suggestion: Prefix option ids with the project/module id.

MCM_GET_IN_ON_LOAD.message: ui_mcm.get is called while on_mcm_load builds the option tree.
MCM_GET_IN_ON_LOAD.suggestion: Return only the option tree from on_mcm_load; read settings later at runtime or on apply callbacks.

MCM_KEYBIND_VAL.message: MCM key_bind option does not declare val = 2.
MCM_KEYBIND_VAL.suggestion: Set key_bind val = 2 and use descriptive localization ids.

MCM_MISSING_ON_LOAD.message: MCM script file does not expose on_mcm_load.
MCM_MISSING_ON_LOAD.suggestion: Define function on_mcm_load() and return a valid options tree.

MONKEY_PATCH.message: Lua code appears to monkey patch an existing table/function.
MONKEY_PATCH.suggestion: Prefer callbacks/config hooks. If patching is required, preserve the original function and document load-order risk.

NAMING_GENERIC_ID.message: Generic custom id/name increases addon conflict risk.
NAMING_GENERIC_ID.suggestion: Use a stable project/module prefix for callbacks, sections, options, and script-level ids.

PATCH_FULL_LTX_OVERRIDE.message: LTX file overrides a known vanilla file.
PATCH_FULL_LTX_OVERRIDE.suggestion: Prefer a DLTX patch when Modded Exes is available.

PATCH_FULL_XML_OVERRIDE.message: XML file overrides a known vanilla file.
PATCH_FULL_XML_OVERRIDE.suggestion: Prefer DXML or a narrow XML diff when Modded Exes is available.

SAVE_MISSING_VERSION.message: Persistent save/load code has no visible state version.
SAVE_MISSING_VERSION.suggestion: Add STATE_VERSION, store it with serialized data, and migrate defaults on load.

SAVE_NON_SERIALIZABLE.message: Save-state code appears to store an engine object or function.
SAVE_NON_SERIALIZABLE.suggestion: Store only serializable ids/primitive values and rebuild transient engine references after load.
